# streamsec_gcp_scanner_hub (Resource)

Makes a GCP project's agentless volume scanner a hub: it also scans other GCP projects, as its own service account, where that account holds the scanned-projects role (the google-integration module's `modules/volume-scanner-hub-access`, or the console's command, grants it). Destroying it turns the hub off: each project goes back to its own scanner.

A project a hub scanned while its coverage was `selected` stays pinned to that hub after it switches to `all`, and another hub can't select it (Stream Security answers 409). To release it, set that hub to `selected` without the project, apply, then set it back to `all`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The security project's volume scanner also scans the dev and prod projects.
resource "streamsec_gcp_scanner_hub" "security" {
  account_id  = streamsec_gcp_project.security.id
  coverage    = "selected"
  account_ids = [streamsec_gcp_project.dev.id, streamsec_gcp_project.prod.id]
}

# The shared-services project's scanner scans every other GCP project that has no
# scanner of its own and no other hub. Only one hub may cover "all".
resource "streamsec_gcp_scanner_hub" "shared_services" {
  account_id = streamsec_gcp_project.shared_services.id
  coverage   = "all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Stream Security id of the hub's GCP project (`streamsec_gcp_project.<name>.id`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `coverage` (String) Which projects the hub scans: `all` (every other GCP project without a scanner of its own and not scanned by another hub) or `selected` (the projects in `account_ids`). Only one hub may cover `all`.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) The Stream Security ids of the GCP projects the hub scans (`streamsec_gcp_project.<name>.id`). Required when `coverage` is `selected` (an empty set scans none); must be unset or empty when `coverage` is `all`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A scanner hub is imported by the Stream Security id of its GCP project.
terraform import streamsec_gcp_scanner_hub.security 64f1c0ffee0123456789abcd
```
